title: Check intermediate ranges before reassociation or hoisting
applies_when: Fusion, quantization algebra or validation hoisting changes where a low-precision product, subtraction, accumulation or cast occurs.
lesson: Compare intermediate ranges and rounding points in the original and rewritten expressions. A representable final mathematical result can still overflow during evaluation. Test legal extrema and cancellation cases alongside ordinary inputs; retain required casts or use a permitted wider accumulator when the new expression exceeds its dtype range.
avoid_when: Real-number algebra alone does not justify a floating-point rewrite. This lesson does not prohibit reassociation when the operator contract permits its numerical effect and range analysis covers the legal domain.

evidence.note: PyTorch gives an intermediate-overflow example with a representable mathematical result. This supports the range hazard, not a speed or correctness claim for a specific rewrite.
